Definition: to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively, to go forward, be honest, proper
BiblicalUsage: 1) to go straight, walk, go on, advance, make progress; 1a)(Qal) to go straight on, make progress; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to go straight on, advance; 1b2) to lead on (causative); 1b3) to set right, righten; 1b4) to pronounce happy, call blessed; 1c) (Pual); 1c1) to be advanced, be led on; 1c2) to be made happy, be blessed
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
